title: ipfs mcp agent settings: error shape
description: Error body of the settings route and its test-connection and model-list endpoints. code is the stable machine-readable code; the set below is closed and grows only by a contract change, so clients can switch on it. HTTP statuses: backend_not_configured 503 (no backend is configured; also the /agui answer with no backend), revision_conflict 412 (missing or stale If-Match revision), egress_confirmation_required 409 (the write would change the model host without a matching egress_confirmation), secrets_not_accepted 403 (a secret field was sent while agent.settings.accept_secrets is false). Authentication and route-absent failures (401, 404) are HTTP-level and are not this document.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. backend_not_configured: no backend configured (503). revision_conflict: missing or stale If-Match (412). egress_confirmation_required: the write changes the model host without a matching egress_confirmation (409). secrets_not_accepted: a secret field was sent while accept_secrets is false (403).

message.description: Human-readable message. Never includes credentials or key material.

details.description: Code-specific data, for example the current revision for revision_conflict or the unconfirmed host for egress_confirmation_required. Never includes credentials or key material.
